sloka: कथम् स धर्मम् जानीते येन भ्रात्रा दुरात्मना ।युद्धाय अभिनियुक्तेन बिलस्य पिहितम् मुखम् ॥४-५५-४॥
transliteration: katham sa dharmam jānīte yena bhrātrā durātmanā ।yuddhāya abhiniyuktena bilasya pihitam mukham ॥4-55-4॥

translations.english: 'He usurped his elder brother's queen, while he was still alive. It is morally abominable since an elder brother's wife is like a mother. How can a person who blocks the entrance of a cave while his noble brother is engaged in fighting inside be treated as righteous?
translations.hindi: निश्चय ही प्राणियों को, उन अच्छे बुरे फल भिला करते हैं के पूर्वाज्ित कर्मा के फलानुसार । देखो, उसीदे बहुत दिन्नँ वाद यह भोजन मुझे कुणा! ड मिला हे
